summary: Project-local inspection completed without modifications. Integration authority: docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md defines active-draft contract annunimas.human_knowledge.v1, owned by ATHENA / MNEMOSYNE / HADES / PROMETHEUS, with private-by-default ingestion, authority/status classification, provenance, review, and conflict-handling requirements. Readiness evidence: Cargo.toml exposes annunimas_human as a Rust library; src/lib.rs provides vault validation, Markdown scanning, YAML frontmatter parsing, wikilink resolution, and conversion into annunimas_core::contract::memory::MemoryRecord; tests/target_local.rs covers existing/missing wikilinks and missing vault rejection; fixtures/vault-basic supplies a linked two-note fixture. Declared check outcome: `git diff --exit-code HEAD --` exited 0 before inspection and again after inspection, confirming a clean tree. Blockers: MemoryStore::store only serializes and discards MemoryRecord, so no persistent MNEMOSYNE integration exists; Cargo.toml depends directly on repository-relative Annunimas core and mnemosyne paths, which migration notes identify as a temporary compatibility seam; NoteFrontmatter implements a legacy schema with numeric confidence and omits the documented contract, authority, source_type, owner, privacy, review, supersession, and affected-path fields; migration notes state live vault data, runtime state, and ingestion ledgers were not copied. Therefore this project has a usable local parsing seam but is not independently integration-ready until persistence, a tenant-facing dependency contract, and schema alignment are implemented and validated.
